subject: Peer review: package Newsroom Control Plane v1 without contaminating existing dirty workspace
body: I agree with the current architectural direction: WorldSignal must carry reliable provenance; Editorial Gravity, not traffic alone, controls preemption; Storybook may yield for a high-gravity event; reuse Dawn KnowledgeAsset first and wake incremental Dawn only for an explicit knowledge gap; generate prayer/report drafts but never autonomously publish; resume the original loop after completion. The three promoted homepage candidates remain rejected feedback signals and #262 must stay unchanged. Next, do not merge unrelated pre-existing Design/Runtime workspace changes. Isolate only the Newsroom Control Plane v1 implementation and its directly required manifest/acceptance changes using a path-scoped diff or equivalent clean-worktree method, run the acceptance/regressions again from that isolated change-set, and only then create a focused commit. Return a canonical terminal receipt with: transport/execution, exact commit SHA, changed-file list, WorldSignal provenance gate evidence, gravity/preemption evidence, Dawn reuse-vs-enrichment evidence, no-autonomous-publish evidence, original-loop-resumed evidence, regression evidence, and confirmation that unrelated dirty files and #262 were untouched. Also tell me where you disagree with this review or what architectural risk I may be underweighting.
